# SYMIDIC | AI Customer Support & Automation Agency for Shopify

> SYMIDIC is an elite AI automation agency specializing in 24/7 autonomous customer support agents, e-commerce automation, and intelligent inventory workflows for high-growth Shopify brands.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous Shopify Support:** Resolves WISMO (Where Is My Order), return requests, exchanges, order edits, and refunds with zero human latency (< 850ms response time).
- **Intelligent Human Handoff:** Seamless triage and routing to human agents when sentiment drops or complex exceptions arise.
- **AI Product Recommendations:** Personalized contextual cross-sells and upsells directly within chat, driving a 15-22% increase in average order value (AOV).
- **Omnichannel Integration:** Native bi-directional sync across Shopify Plus, Gorgias, Zendesk, WhatsApp, Instagram DMs, and email.

## Key Performance Metrics
- **Ticket Deflection:** 78% of repetitive tier-1 customer inquiries resolved autonomously.
- **Resolution Accuracy:** 99.8% factual accuracy with zero hallucinations via strict RAG knowledge base guardrails.
- **Response Latency:** Sub-850ms average response time across all channels.
- **Availability:** 24/7/365 continuous uptime.
